text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does notvouch for their accuracy:
- Parliament approves Central Bank and Kuwait Investment Authority 1996/97 budgets, suspends municipality budget.
- 184 candidates have registered their names for the October parliamentary elections so far. September 14 is the closing day for registration.

- Banks collect 70 percent of the second annual instalment in a programme to settle bad debts. The debts, orginally worth $20 billion, are owed by the private sector to the state. Commercial banks are managing the plan on behalf of the state, which bought their debt portfolios in 1992.
- Twenty shares rise in active trade at the Kuwait Stock Exchange led by investment companies.
- Ministry of communications collects 55 million dinars ($183 million) in delayed payments.
- Four acting ministers take the oath after the procedural resignation of four ministers who wanted to run for parliament.
